cause: Goldfish EGL exposed config index zero as a null EGLConfig; Chromium aborted display initialization and its app exited. Configuration selection also returned host GLES3 configurations unsupported by the guest GLES2 decoder.
fix: Encode public EGLConfig handles as index + 1, convert back at renderControl calls, validate handles centrally and return zero matches for unsupported guest renderable bits.

regression.before: GLES2 and GLES3 selections returned count=1, handle=0; the Java probe asserted and WebView reported No suitable EGL configs found for initialization
regression.after: GLES3 returned count=0; GLES2 returned count=1, handle=1; egl_config_non_null_handles=1
regression.nativeChecks: Configuration handles, texture sharing and native video buffers passed on the local GPU

deviceVerification.pageChecks: HTTP 200, document complete, visible page and live process for all three URLs
deviceVerification.viaChecks: User page visible, process alive and no EGL initialization crash

coverage: Native EGL checks on Adreno 830 and 616 with SDK 36; other Android versions and continuous Via video playback remain outside this result. No host model, UID or SDK-specific exception was introduced.
